info.title: ACL
info.description: RESTful interface for AOS-CX switch software

cfg_aces.description:
Reference Resource: [ACL_Entry](#/ACL_Entry)
ACL entries as configured by the user. An empty column value indicates that no match criteria is specified for this list.

cfg_version.description: The version of 'cfg_aces' that should be changed to a random value each time 'cfg_aces' is modified. An empty column value will indicate that the user does not want the system to process this configuration yet.

cur_aces.description:
Reference Resource: [ACL_Entry](#/ACL_Entry)
ACL entries that are currently programmed in the data path.

in_progress_aces.description:
Reference Resource: [ACL_Entry](#/ACL_Entry)
ACL entries that are being processed for installation into the data path.

in_progress_version.description: The version of the 'in_progress' Access Control List.  This value is copied from 'cfg_version' when the ACL processing begins. This value is cleared when the ACL status is updated to 'applied' or 'rejected'.

interfaces_in_statistics.description: Per access list entry hit counts, summarized across interfaces on ingress direction where ACL is attached. Only applies to the entries with counting enabled. Maximum allowed sequence_number is 1 sequence greater than user defined cfg_aces' maximum limit, reserved for the implicit deny entry.

interfaces_out_statistics.description: Per access list entry hit counts, summarized across interfaces on egress direction where ACL is attached. Only applies to the entries with counting enabled.Maximum allowed sequence_number is 1 sequence greater than user defined cfg_aces' maximum limit, reserved for the implicit deny entry.

list_type.description:
Reference Resource: [ACL](#/ACL)
Type of an Access Control List.

name.description:
Reference Resource: [ACL](#/ACL)
Name of an Access Control List.

statistics_clear_performed.description: The number of times a request was performed to clear the statistics for this ACL for each application type or 'all' application types.

statistics_clear_requested.description: The number of times a request was made to clear the statistics for this ACL for each application type or 'all' application types.

code.description: Numeric error code.  Expected to be 0 when the state is 'applied'.

message.description: Detailed reason for error state.  Empty when the state is 'applied'.

version.description: The version of 'cfg_aces' that corresponds to this status.

vlans_in_statistics.description: Per access list entry hit counts, summarized across vlans on ingress direction where ACL is attached. Only applies to the entries with counting enabled. Maximum allowed sequence_number is 1 sequence greater than user defined cfg_aces' maximum limit, reserved for the implicit deny entry.

vlans_out_statistics.description: Per access list entry hit counts, summarized across vlans on egress direction where ACL is attached. Only applies to the entries with counting enabled. Maximum allowed sequence_number is 1 sequence greater than user defined cfg_aces' maximum limit, reserved for the implicit deny entry.

vlans_routed_in_statistics.description: Per access list entry hit counts, summarized across route-only vlans on routed ingress direction where ACL is attached. Only applies to the entries with counting enabled. Maximum allowed sequence_number is 1 sequence greater than user defined cfg_aces' maximum limit, reserved for the implicit deny entry.

vlans_routed_out_statistics.description: Per access list entry hit counts, summarized across route-only vlans on routed egress direction where ACL is attached. Only applies to the entries with counting enabled.  Maximum allowed sequence_number is 1 sequence greater than user defined cfg_aces' maximum limit, reserved for the implicit deny entry.

vrfs_control_plane_statistics.description: Per access list entry hit counts, summarized across vrfs on control-plane direction where ACL is attached. Only applies to the entries with counting enabled. Maximum allowed sequence_number is 1 sequence greater than user defined cfg_aces' maximum limit, reserved for the implicit deny entry.

vsx_sync.description: Controls which attributes should be synchronized between VSX peers. 'all_attributes_and_dependents': the entire ACL, including ACEs, should be synchronized. This column value should be empty when system should not synchronize attributes between VSX peers.

parameters.name: attributes
parameters.description: Columns to display.

parameters.name: depth
parameters.description: Depth to traverse.

parameters.name: selector
parameters.description: Select configuration, status and/or statistics. Default is all categories.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter rows by attribute values.  Format: attribute:value

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Count the number of rows found.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Entity-tag value for representation comparison (see RFC 7232 - Conditional Requests - section 3.2)
